title: Define and write the replay format
lead: Specify and write a versioned replay file (format per C23) from the VM events, with a stable replay hash and replay-equivalence tests.
boundary: **Not in this slice:** viewers; a binary format.

sections.heading: Why
sections.body: Goal 7 and acceptance criteria C16 and C19. Replay-equivalence tests and golden hashes are the named mitigation for determinism bugs.

sections.heading: Files
sections.body:
- `docs/spec/replay.md` (new).
- Replay package: writer, reader, hash, tests.
- A CLI option on `arena run` to write a replay.

sections.heading: Failing tests
sections.body:
- The replay of a fixed match matches a golden fixture and hash.
- Reading a replay and applying it reconstructs the same core state at every cycle as the live simulation (replay equivalence).
- An unknown version is rejected with a clear error.
- The imp vs dwarf seed 1 replay hash is stable across runs.

sections.heading: Implement
sections.body:
- Header: version, match config, bot hashes. Body: per-cycle events (writes, process spawn and death), per the data model.
- Seek support: decide within C23 whether to add periodic snapshots.
- Gap: the hash function must be stable across machines and versions. Check whether the confirmed stack's standard library provides one with that guarantee; if not, it needs an in-repo implementation or an approved dependency (C13). Owner decides.
- JSON writing without a serialization dependency unless the owner approves one (C13).
- Gap: PROJECT.md does not name the CLI option for writing a replay; propose it.

sections.heading: Check
sections.body:
- The project test command passes.
- The same match run twice gives identical replay files (`cmp`) and hashes.

sections.heading: Git
sections.body: Branch `slice/<id>-replay` in `.worktrees/<id>`. One commit when the owner asks.
